_comment: Committed PDK defaults for this repo. Environment variables win over this
file, and sim/pdk.local.json (git-ignored) wins over both.
variant       gf180mcu flavor directory to use (A/B/C/D differ in metal stack)
search_roots  extra directories that CONTAIN variant dirs, searched before
variant is pinned to gf180mcuC per DR-0010 (spec/decisions/0010-pdk-variant.md,
issue #9), which resolved the gf180mcuC-vs-gf180mcuD discrepancy this file
previously pinned gf180mcuD around: gf180mcuC matches every layout artifact
already committed (layout/, from #2) and is the conservative (thinner top-
metal) assumption for pad ESD margin. DR-0010 also found the two variants'
SPICE device models (libs.tech/ngspice) are byte-identical, so this pin
change does not itself invalidate any already-recorded sim/ result numerically
-- only their citation strings are stale (see DR-0010's Consequences and
sim/README.md's 'PDK variant' section for the full account, including which
